errors.evidence: The description incorrectly interprets the orange line. The orange line shows the year-on-year percentage growth, not the 'share of the total number of buyers'.

errors.text_span: Оста X представлява годината и показва стойностите 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021 и 2023.
errors.evidence: The description omits the year 2022 from the list of values shown on the x-axis.
The description hallucinates the upper value of the y-axis range. The axis goes up to 3,00, not 3,32. The value 3.32 does not appear anywhere in the chart.

errors.text_span: Диапазонът на стойностите на оста Y е от 0 до 3,32.
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates the upper value of the y-axis range. The axis goes up to 3,00, not 3,32. The value 3.32 does not appear anywhere in the chart.

errors.text_span: Тази линия намалява от 1,79 в 2018 г. до 1,92 в 2019 г. и се запазва при 2,05 в 2020 г., след което намалява до 2,14 в 2021 г. и се запазва при 2,32 в 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the blue line (number of buyers) decreases and remains constant at several points. In reality, the blue line shows a consistent increase every year from 2017 to 2023.

errors.text_span: Втората линия е оранжева и представлява делът на интернет купувачите от общия брой купувачи.
errors.evidence: This is a repetition of a previous error. The orange line represents the percentage growth rate, not the 'share of internet buyers'.

errors.text_span: Линията започва при стойност 7,3% в 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The orange line does not have a value for 2017. The first percentage value shown is 7.8% for the year 2018. The value 7.3% corresponds to the year 2019.

errors.text_span: Линията се увеличава от 7,8% в 2018 г. до 8,4% в 2022 г.
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization that misrepresents the trend of the orange line. The line does not simply increase; it first decreases from 7.8% (2018) to 4.4% (2021), and then increases to 8.4% (2022).
